summary: Portal release, mobile release, store-asset preflight, live Stripe API authentication, live Stripe webhook handling, iOS App Store-safe E2E, Android targeted recovery, fresh iOS store build 16, and fresh Android store build 7 evidence are green. App Store submission remains blocked by an expired or missing Apple agreement. Google Play automated submit is blocked until the first Play Console submission is completed manually. Live Stripe account charging remains blocked by Stripe account requirements until the business website URL is fixed in Dashboard.

gates.evidence: cd portal && npm run release:check passed: release-env-ok:production, stripe-auth-ok, typecheck, lint, 53 Vitest tests, and Next production build.

cd unit && npm run release:check passed: release env, materialized inputs, store submission assets, edge guard, lint, typecheck, brand-lint, 19 Jest suites / 87 tests, and Expo Doctor 18/18. Warning only: EXPO_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN recommended but unset.

cd unit && npm run release:check-store-assets passed: production Expo config, 1024x1024 icons, iOS PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy, EAS submit targets, required iOS/Android screenshot assets, and store metadata are present and valid.
Production-target iOS App Store-safe Maestro suite passed 28/28.
Production-target Android rerun passed install gate plus the three formerly failing flows with persistent Maestro driver enabled.

Stripe live endpoint we_1TnHM9I7Rfm7lgejX4aVTLej is enabled for https://unit-portal-one.vercel.app/api/webhooks/stripe with checkout.session.completed, checkout.session.expired, and payment_intent.payment_failed on API 2026-04-22.dahlia.
cd portal && npm run release:check-stripe-auth returned stripe-auth-ok for the configured live Stripe account.

Stripe account acct_1TT2JII7Rfm7lgej authenticates and can create card Checkout Sessions, but Stripe account readiness reports charges_enabled=false, payouts_enabled=false, business_profile.url=CultrVentures.com, currently_due=[business_profile.url], past_due=[business_profile.url], error code invalid_url_website_inaccessible.
gates.blocker: Update the Stripe Dashboard business website URL to a reachable production URL such as https://unit-tenant-app.netlify.app and wait for Stripe account requirements to clear before treating live charging as production-ready.

EAS build 395a00fb-1156-4b3f-a79b-43fb8e6989ac finished for Android production STORE distribution, version 1.0.0 versionCode 7, commit c26988cef18c60b972f15dcfc344f66dbf61f186.

eas submit --platform android --profile production --id 395a00fb-1156-4b3f-a79b-43fb8e6989ac scheduled submission 013e3286-9a3c-40d6-8f94-e785ede64d2b, then Google Play rejected automation because the first app submission must be performed manually.
gates.blocker: Upload Android build 395a00fb-1156-4b3f-a79b-43fb8e6989ac / versionCode 7 manually in Google Play Console for the first submission. After that first manual submission exists, rerun cd unit && npm run release:android:submit for automated internal-track submission.

gates.evidence: cd unit && npm run appstore:auth:check fails with Apple message: A required agreement is missing or has expired.
gates.blocker: Apple account holder must accept the missing or expired App Store Connect agreement.

hardBlockers.summary: Stripe live account is authenticated but charges are disabled because Stripe requires a reachable business website URL.
hardBlockers.ownerAction: In Stripe Dashboard for UNIT APP, replace business_profile.url=CultrVentures.com with a reachable URL such as https://unit-tenant-app.netlify.app, then rerun stripe get /v1/account --live and verify charges_enabled=true before public paid checkout.

hardBlockers.summary: App Store Connect API access is blocked by a missing or expired Apple agreement.
hardBlockers.ownerAction: Account Holder signs the pending agreement in App Store Connect, then rerun cd unit && npm run appstore:auth:check and cd unit && npm run release:ios:submit.

hardBlockers.summary: Google Play automated upload is blocked because this app has not had its first Play Console submission yet.
hardBlockers.ownerAction: In Google Play Console, manually upload Android build 395a00fb-1156-4b3f-a79b-43fb8e6989ac / versionCode 7 to the internal track once. Then rerun cd unit && npm run release:android:submit.

acceptedWarnings.summary: Sentry DSNs are recommended but not required by the current release checks. Launch can proceed only if the owner accepts reduced crash/portal telemetry, or DSNs are configured before release.

Vercel has STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET present, but exact encrypted value matching cannot be proven locally after Stripe secret creation. First live checkout must verify webhook delivery before public launch.
